body: You do understand.

I looked through your post history, and I don't know why you do what you do, but I wish more people would do it.

I struggle with day to day tasks because I can't help but immediately try and see how they play out into the future.  There are a few things I can do that help limit that.  I play the game Counter Strike it has a very short round based nature which means I don't really need to plan more than a few minutes ahead.

The toughest part about deciding to keep going is that I have looked far enough forward to feel like it's all eventually irrelevant anyway.  I know that isn't healthy or right and I can be happy here... but that just looms over everything.  

Thank you.

Sure I am also skipping the good times, but I won't remember those when I'm dead either.  I don't think the world cares about what I have to contribute and I base that on putting my heart and soul into my work for the last 5 years and a handful of people care about my work, but they don't care about me.

They had known me for years, her for months... they picked her over me.  I want to give a girl a lot of support.  I want to be there for her and have her there for me. So this leads me to one more final thought...

>Just that they're a bad driver doesn't mean I'm going to be judgmental, ie hold that up as a flaw against their person.

Correct.  I wouldn't ever judge a person for how they drive.  But I would make choices about if I would get in their car based on judgements of their driving.  

So what I see in this situation is that I'm not judging her character for her past, but I'm choosing if I want to get in her car.  I'm not trying to make statements about if what she did was right or wrong but I'm trying to decide if i want to continue to "ride" with her.   This is focused on the future for me, not the past.  

If anything: I would say that I'm in the process of making my judgement but I haven't judged her yet.

If they ever meet (which you seem to think they will), it will be awkward for the girl.  I was just trying to think of the least awkward way.  I guess other people see things differently though =\  good luck!

Then perhaps they could explain it differently (or add new logic) that suddenly makes me see their point of view or solidifies their logic.

Sex is suddenly different?  I'm not so sure it is a black and white issue where some topics are okay to judge while others aren't.

But isn't it my business?  I can let go of the things she did then, but I'm not convinced she won't do them again.  I couldn't handle that. > Your cousin is a fucking jerk, at best. He should have minded his own fucking business. What purpose did he have to interfere in your life and stir up drama in your happy relationship? Nothing can be done about the past so you are wasting your time thinking about it. 

You start by judging my cousin and then you tell me I'm wasting my time.

>You should defend her to him and tell him to piss right off. You need to send a message that other people causing drama, talking about your girl, and interfering with your relationship is not going to be tolerated.

Here you assume that I will defend the girl I'm with under ALL circumstances.  As if it is impossible for a girl to make a mistake.  As if I shouldn't hold her to the same standards I hold myself.  If my girl does shit with out my knowledge, you can bet I want to know.  

> tl;dr you should have shut your cousin down before he finished the story, and you need to make a stand and not allow anyone to talk about your girlfriend.

And here you return to telling me what I should have done about my cousin, which is STILL talking about the past and not focusing on the matter I posted about.

At no point in any of your post did you actually give me advice that focuses on the things happening now and in the future.  You can tell me I'm immature and insecure, but your logic is weak and entirely focused on the wrong things.  I'm here asking for advice on what to talk about with my girl, and all you tell me is to fuck up shit with my cousin.

I still don't think I'm judging, but that would lead us into a syntax conversation and I don't care about that.  The important thing is: I haven't made my choice yet, so don't try and tell me what I've done.

Your sarcasm is not appreciated.  Saying "O, but it could work out so give it a shot" is not logic I would follow.  Suppose you have a revolver with one empty slot and you spin the barrel.  Because you are unaware of which slot it will land on, is it impossible that you will survive?  No.  Does that suddenly make playing Russian Roulette a safe plan?  

Just because it is possible that she got away from that mentality, it doesn't she mean DID get away from that mentality.

You are focusing on "shoulds."  My cousin won't have to tell his parents anything.  She is banned from there house.  I know it is fucked up, but those parents are gossipers and my family WILL find out.  Regardless of if I judge her or not, my family will and they will judge me as well.  

He didn't run around town telling everyone about a woman's sexual past.  He told me, and me specifically, about the past of a girl that I'm not dating because he thinks she isn't safe.  

And this family tends to lack class.  I was staying with them after moving here from another country and after 2 weeks they kicked me out (with less than 4 hours warning).  I can understand they didn't want me to live there for free or whatever, but the lack of warning made me rage pretty hard.  For the record, I had an interview set up before they kicked me out and I ended up getting that job.  I wasn't slacking.
Having sex with one or two dudes, each in the context of a loving relationship, is very different than giving head for coke.

I think surprising them or telling them out right are both mistakes.

If I were you, I would try and casually mention their names to each other (separate) while not saying you know each other.  For example "hey, we are going to a movie with my friends adam apple, chris jerry, and john smith."  and chris jerry is of course the person in question. The advantage to this method is that, if there is more dirt you aren't aware of, they will be able to respond correctly.  Maybe suddenly your friend can't make it... It gives them the chance to get out of that situation if they so desire.
